title: AgentEval MetricsBaseline
description: Evidence-bearing regression baseline snapshot (OpenSpec add-regression-baseline-tracking, design Decision 1 + 6). schema_version 1. Proportion metrics store successes+trials (so Wilson CIs are recomputable at any confidence level and Pass@k for any k<=trials); continuous metrics store the raw per-trial sample list (so Mann-Whitney U comparison is possible run-over-run). Serialized deterministically (indent=2, sort_keys, trailing newline) and redacted at the write boundary. Phase-2 stability label: experimental.

schema_version.description: Baseline schema version. A future release bumping this raises BaselineSchemaError on older builds.

metrics.description: Map of metric name -> evidence entry. Proportion names: pass_rate, pass_at_<k>, tool_hit_rate. Continuous names: cost_usd, latency_p95_ms.

k.description: Requested k for pass_at_k (value is the HumanEval estimator); null for pass_rate / tool_hit_rate.

samples.description: Raw per-trial sample list; makes Mann-Whitney U comparison possible run-over-run.

value.description: Designated comparison point (cost_usd -> mean; latency_p95_ms -> p95).

samples_truncated.description: Reserved for a future sample cap (no cap imposed in Phase 1).

runContext.description: Reproducibility metadata. model/adapter/library are informational and never gate a comparison (design D7); git fields are best-effort (design D10).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the snapshot (runtime clock or caller-supplied).
